policy: References informed proportions, appendage layout and colour placement only. No pixels were sampled, traced, copied or redistributed. Seller imagery was not used as a texture or tracing source. fable-v2 body depth (about 0.58 of standard length) and the distinct proboscis-like snout follow the user's 2026-09-03 refinement notes and the Zebrasoma genus descriptions (body depth 1.4 to 1.75 in SL) summarised on FishBase.
